Clinical

Patient Monitoring

Nurses should be with patients — not chasing alarms.

BLE wearable patches connect to a unified dashboard, routing alerts by severity to the right person on the right screen. SpO₂, ECG, heart rate, temperature, and respiratory rate — continuously, reliably, without wires tethering patients to their beds.

  • →BLE wearable patches for ambulatory patients
  • →HL7 FHIR integration with existing HIS/EMR
  • →Early Warning Score (EWS) auto-calculation
  • →Sepsis and clinical deterioration flags
Patient Experience

Self Service Kiosk

Reduce waiting time before staff even step in.

Self-service kiosks for patient registration, appointment check-in, token management, billing support, consent forms, and visitor management. Designed for hospitals, clinics, diagnostics centers, and reception areas where queues somehow become a full-time lifestyle.

  • →Patient self check-in and registration
  • →Appointment token and queue management
  • →Insurance and ID verification
  • →Digital consent form capture
Facility Intelligence

Environmental Monitoring

Hospitals are hard enough without temperature and humidity causing chaos.

Monitor indoor environmental conditions across wards, ICUs, labs, pharmacies, operation theatres, and storage areas. Ensure compliance, reduce equipment risk, and stop vaccines, medicines, and sensitive devices from quietly suffering in the wrong room conditions.

  • →Temperature and humidity monitoring
  • →Air quality and CO₂ tracking
  • →Differential pressure monitoring for OT and ICU
  • →Cold storage and vaccine refrigerator alerts
Operations

RTLS Asset Tracking

Every piece of equipment, accounted for — always.

Hospital staff lose over 30 minutes per shift searching for equipment. AnantLink RTLS builds a real-time picture of every tracked asset — infusion pumps, ventilators, wheelchairs, defibrillators — across floors, wings, and buildings. So no one needs to go looking again.

  • →Sub-3m indoor positioning via BLE beacon mesh
  • →Asset utilisation and idle-time analytics
  • →Auto-trigger for sterilisation workflows
  • →Exit and zone alerts for theft prevention
Infrastructure

Hospital Automation

The hospital that runs itself — so staff can focus on care.

From the moment a patient occupies a bed, the environment responds: lighting adjusts, HVAC follows occupancy, nurse-call connects to the right staff member's phone. Code-blue sequences trigger automatically. Room turnaround happens without anyone filing a housekeeping request.

  • →Occupancy-based HVAC and lighting control
  • →Smart nurse-call with mobile staff routing
  • →Code-blue and code-red automated sequencing
  • →Bed sensor integration — fall detection, turn reminders
Intelligence

Hospital Digital Twin

See what is really happening — before you need to react.

A live 3D model of your hospital that mirrors physical reality. Patients, assets, staff, environment, and capacity — visualised together in one place. Use it to spot a bottleneck before it becomes a crisis, simulate a surge before it arrives, or understand a past incident without guesswork.

  • →3D floor-plan with live data overlay
  • →Capacity planning and surge event simulation
  • →Infection control zone modelling
  • →Staff distribution and workload heat maps
Analytics

AI Analytics Dashboard

Decisions that used to take a committee — delivered every morning.

Sensor data from across your hospital becomes operational intelligence: bed occupancy forecasts, equipment maintenance predictions, staff workload alerts, infection risk scores, and energy audit reports — all on one command screen without a data analyst in the loop.

  • →Bed occupancy forecasting (72-hour horizon)
  • →Predictive maintenance for medical equipment
  • →Infection risk scoring from environmental sensors
  • →Safe-staffing level and fatigue alerts
Infrastructure

BLE IoT Infrastructure

The foundation that everything else is built on.

An enterprise-grade Bluetooth Low Energy gateway mesh that covers your entire campus — secure, low-power, and vendor-agnostic. It works with the tags and sensors you already own, and can extend to Wi-Fi HaLow or LoRa for specialist coverage requirements.

  • →Enterprise BLE 5.x gateway mesh deployment
  • →Vendor-agnostic tag and sensor compatibility
  • →AES-128 encrypted data, on-premise option available
  • →Edge computing hubs for sub-50ms local processing
